HHND.description: Heat of Hydration Result Graph Node (HHND). Defines a monitoring point for heat-of-hydration stress results; TYPE selects whether the point is picked by node or by element, and COMP selects which stress component is graphed.

NAME.description: Name of the heat-of-hydration result graph point.

TYPE.description: Pick mode. 0 = Select Node (use NODE_KEY only), 1 = Select Element (use NODE_KEY together with ELEM_KEY; ELEM_KEY is forced to 0 when TYPE is not 1).

NODE_KEY.description: Node number of the monitoring point.

ELEM_KEY.description: [TYPE=1] Element number the node belongs to. Only applied when TYPE is 1 (Select Element); stored as 0 otherwise.

COMP.description: Stress component to graph. 0 = Sig-xx, 1 = Sig-yy, 2 = Sig-zz, 3 = Max(P1,P2,P3), 4 = Sig-P1, 5 = Sig-P2, 6 = Sig-P3.
